name: Beast Essence
description: Luminescent core fluid extracted from Ancient Beasts. Vital for upgrading beast-forged equipment and unlocking alliance battle buffs.

name: Crownmarks
description: Sovereign royal currency used in the High Council. Trade these for premium progression artifacts and legendary hero fragments.

name: Astral Steel Core
description: A dense, stellar metal nugget salvaged from deep lair fissures. Required to forge Sovereign-tier weaponry and armor.

name: Sovereign Diamonds
description: Pure crystalline diamond shards infused with Crownspire magical energy. The primary premium currency of the realm.

name: Royal Gold Chest
description: A heavy ironbound strongbox brimming with royal gold. Instantly adds 50,000 Gold to your warehouse reserves.

name: Sovereign Tome of Secrets
description: An ancient leather-bound record of military campaigns. Grants 25,000 Hero Experience when read.

name: 8-Hour Master Speedup
description: An hourglass blessed by the temporal mages. Substracts 8 hours from any ongoing building upgrade, troop training, or research queue.

name: Feral Mark
description: Seasonal event token obtained from defeating map landmarks. Exchange these in the Royal Outpost shop for special cosmetic frames.
